sources.title: Introducing NVFP4 for Efficient and Accurate Low-Precision Inference
sources.snippet: AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Blackwell's NVFP4, a 4-bit floating point format, is designed to improve model accuracy at ultra-low precision by using a two-level scaling strategy that includes a fine-grained E4M3 scaling factor and a second-level FP32 scalar.
